value.author: Кatty
value.title: Exceptional
value.text: Мені сподобалось розташування готелю,зручно і до Голубої Мечеті і до усіх видатних пам'яток усюди добиралася пішки.І звісно класний персонал усі допомагали,розказували як куди дойти ітд.

value.author: Manuel
value.title: Pleasant
value.text:
Emplacement au top
— La piscine était un peu froide
Les transats sont a changer

value.author: Didier
value.title: Zeer goede ligging metro tram, basic hotel, goed voor een paar overnachtingen.
value.text: — Er lag bij onze aankomst een paperclip op het tapijt, bij vertrek nog steeds, dus 4 dagen niet gestofzuigd. In de lade van mijn nachtkastje stond mijn medicatie plots aan de andere kant, vreemd.

value.author: Reilly
value.title: Staff good but rest of the place a bit outdated and breakfast wasnt the best.
value.text:
Staff super friendly, esp reception team!
— Pool was VERY dirty which was not the best look, room also held a lot of stains which I can usually understand as wear & tear but this was kind of gross. The breakfast was also really not good at all, the first day was chaos and food options each day were just not very good for a breakfast.

value.author: Oscarvd
value.title: Perfect spot for a city trip!
value.text:
Perfect location and nice roof top swimmingpool to have some chill time within the city. Breakfast is a bit busy but has everything you need. I would say perfect place to do a city trip in Istanbul! Climate in the room was nice. We felt lucky to stay on one of the higher floors. Daily cleaning and two bottles of water were very helpfull.
— We asked for some simple linnen sheets and had to find them ourselves in the linnen room. Otherwise we had to sleep under uncomfortable blankets.

value.author: Erzsébet
value.title: Exceptional
value.text:
Tiszta,rendezett kedves kiszolgálás az étteremben és a recepción egyaránt. Valamint a recepción kiemelném Emre Kedvességét. Mindennap az ott létünkkor erdeklődött hogy minden rendben van-e. Mindenben segített. Plusz pont hogy feltötött Istanbul kártya elerhető minden szálló vendég számára. Mi félpanziós ellátással voltunk. Az ételek kiválóak voltak és változatosak. Desszert is volt a vacsorához. Valamint figyelembe vették a tejallergiát.🥰🤩🫶🇹🇷 köszönjük a színvonalas vendéglátást🥰🙏
— Nem volt olyan

value.author: Dinah
value.title: Thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Staff were very helpful.
value.text:
Well positioned in a quiet road in the Old City. Rooftop area very pleasant.
— Carpets in the corridors could be cleaner
